agenda_entries_entity_consistent.name: agenda_entries_entity_consistent
agenda_entries_entity_consistent.value:
("app"."agenda_entries"."entity_kind" = 'project' and "app"."agenda_entries"."project_id" is not null and "app"."agenda_entries"."task_id" is null)
        or ("app"."agenda_entries"."entity_kind" = 'task' and "app"."agenda_entries"."task_id" is not null and "app"."agenda_entries"."project_id" is null)

contacts_owner_linked_user_unique.name: contacts_owner_linked_user_unique
contacts_owner_linked_user_unique.where: "app"."contacts"."linked_user_id" is not null and "app"."contacts"."archived_at" is null

financial_entries_source_consistent.name: financial_entries_source_consistent
financial_entries_source_consistent.value:
("app"."financial_entries"."source" = 'manual' and "app"."financial_entries"."project_id" is null and "app"."financial_entries"."project_installment_id" is null)
        or ("app"."financial_entries"."source" = 'project' and "app"."financial_entries"."project_id" is not null and "app"."financial_entries"."project_installment_id" is not null)

financial_entries_series_consistent.name: financial_entries_series_consistent
financial_entries_series_consistent.value:
("app"."financial_entries"."series_kind" is null and "app"."financial_entries"."series_id" is null and "app"."financial_entries"."series_number" is null and "app"."financial_entries"."series_count" is null)
        or ("app"."financial_entries"."series_kind" in ('installment', 'recurrence') and "app"."financial_entries"."series_id" is not null and "app"."financial_entries"."series_number" between 1 and 999 and "app"."financial_entries"."series_count" between 1 and 999 and "app"."financial_entries"."series_number" <= "app"."financial_entries"."series_count")

projects_dates_ordered.name: projects_dates_ordered
projects_dates_ordered.value: "app"."projects"."start_date" is null or "app"."projects"."end_date" is null or "app"."projects"."end_date" >= "app"."projects"."start_date"

stored_files_dimensions_complete.name: stored_files_dimensions_complete
stored_files_dimensions_complete.value: ("app"."stored_files"."width" is null and "app"."stored_files"."height" is null) or ("app"."stored_files"."width" > 0 and "app"."stored_files"."height" > 0)

tasks_board_order_shape.name: tasks_board_order_shape
tasks_board_order_shape.value:
jsonb_typeof("app"."tasks"."board_order") = 'object'
        and "app"."tasks"."board_order" - 'status' - 'priority' - 'business' - 'project' = '{}'::jsonb
        and (not ("app"."tasks"."board_order" ? 'status') or
          (jsonb_typeof("app"."tasks"."board_order"->'status') = 'number' and
           "app"."tasks"."board_order"->>'status' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'))
        and (not ("app"."tasks"."board_order" ? 'priority') or
          (jsonb_typeof("app"."tasks"."board_order"->'priority') = 'number' and
           "app"."tasks"."board_order"->>'priority' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'))
        and (not ("app"."tasks"."board_order" ? 'business') or
          (jsonb_typeof("app"."tasks"."board_order"->'business') = 'number' and
           "app"."tasks"."board_order"->>'business' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'))
        and (not ("app"."tasks"."board_order" ? 'project') or
          (jsonb_typeof("app"."tasks"."board_order"->'project') = 'number' and
           "app"."tasks"."board_order"->>'project' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'))

user_connections_has_source.name: user_connections_has_source
user_connections_has_source.value: "app"."user_connections"."manual_connected_at" is not null or "app"."user_connections"."workspace_connected_at" is not null

workspace_invitations_acceptance_consist.name: workspace_invitations_acceptance_consistent
workspace_invitations_acceptance_consist.value: ("app"."workspace_invitations"."status" = 'accepted') = ("app"."workspace_invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "app"."workspace_invitations"."accepted_by_user_id" is not null)
